description: Helper functions for testing bitmap performance in a Git repository context.

methods.name: test_full_bitmap
methods.description: Runs a series of performance tests related to bitmap packing and rev-list operations.

methods.name: test_partial_bitmap
methods.description: Runs tests for partial bitmap operations and rev-list filtering.

methods.name: test_pack_bitmap
methods.description: Performs repository packing, simulating old and new tip states, and invokes full and partial bitmap tests.
